title: The ESXi host Secure Shell (SSH) daemon must not allow compression or must only allow compression after successful authentication.
check_content:
From an ESXi shell, run the following command:

# /usr/lib/vmware/openssh/bin/sshd -T|grep compression

Expected result:

compression no

If the output does not match the expected result, this is a finding.
fixtext:
From an ESXi shell, add or correct the following line in "/etc/ssh/sshd_config":

Compression no
VulnDiscussion: If compression is allowed in an SSH connection prior to authentication, vulnerabilities in the compression software could result in compromise of the system from an unauthenticated connection, potentially with root privileges.
